title: LIVORA
description:
BUILD A LIFE. LIVE WITH WHAT FOLLOWS.LIVORA is a modern life simulation where thousands of decisions shape your career, money, relationships, family, health, home and the world around you.

Create your character and build one continuous Life across years and decades.

Work. Study. Manage money. Find somewhere to live. Build relationships. Raise a family. Travel. Invest. Relocate. Deal with setbacks. Take opportunities. Make plans and live with what happens next.

But LIVORA is not a world waiting for you to press a button.

The economy changes. Job markets rise and fall. Neighbourhoods evolve. Partners build careers of their own. Children grow into adults. Relationships develop histories. Places change.

And decisions made today can still matter years later.

ONE LIFE. EVERYTHING CONNECTS.LIVORA is built as one connected simulation.

Your career affects your income and free time.

Money affects where you can live and what you can afford.

Where you live affects travel, opportunities and everyday costs.

Relationships affect your responsibilities and decisions.

Health affects what you can take on.

The wider economy can affect jobs, borrowing, housing and financial pressure.

You are rarely managing one system at a time.

You are managing a Life.

BUILD A CAREER — AND ACTUALLY GO TO WORKSearch for jobs, submit applications and attend playable interviews.

Build your skills and qualifications, develop your career, change direction, retrain, pursue promotions or become self-employed.

Once you have a job, work itself becomes playable.

Deal with colleagues, managers, pressure, workplace situations and decisions that can affect your future.

Other people have careers too. Partners, friends and adult children can experience promotions, redundancy, career changes and opportunities of their own.

LIVE THROUGH A CHANGING ECONOMYYour finances exist inside a wider economy.

Inflation, interest rates, unemployment, hiring confidence, wage growth, rent pressure and property prices can change over time.

Different industries can become stronger or weaker.

A job search during a healthy labour market may feel very different from one during a downturn.

A mortgage that once felt affordable may become more demanding.

The economy keeps moving whether your Life is ready for it or not.

MANAGE MONEY AND BUILD SOMETHINGEarn money, pay bills and manage everyday spending.

Use credit. Build savings. Invest. Plan for retirement. Buy property, vehicles and other assets. Build businesses and track your portfolio as your circumstances grow.

Every decision creates trade-offs.

Spend now or save.

Take more risk or protect what you already have.

Build security or use your money to change your Life.

FIND A HOME — OR START SOMEWHERE NEWRent, buy and move between homes as your Life changes.

Browse properties, attend viewings, submit applications, manage deposits, make offers, arrange mortgages and build equity over time.

You can also relocate somewhere completely different.

Compare places based on housing, career opportunities, transport, affordability and family life, then deal with the real costs and consequences of moving.

Where you live is more than an address.

It can shape the Life available to you.

WATCH THE WORLD AROUND YOU CHANGENeighbourhoods evolve over time.

Housing pressure can rise. Transport can improve or become disrupted. Local projects appear. Community spaces change. Businesses and places can come and go.

Weather, seasons, events, World News and the wider economy all contribute to a world that keeps moving around your character.

The place you move into may not be the same place you eventually leave.

BUILD RELATIONSHIPS WITH A HISTORYMeet people, build friendships, date and form long-term relationships.

Spend time together. Make memories. Handle disagreements. Repair damaged relationships or let them drift apart.

Romantic relationships can develop into cohabitation, engagement, wedding planning, marriage and family life.

But relationships do not automatically succeed.

Partners have careers, pressures and priorities of their own.

Relationships can strengthen, struggle, recover, separate or end in divorce and co-parenting.

People remember how you treated them.

BUILD A FAMILY THAT KEEPS GROWINGChildren do not remain children forever.

They grow through different stages, developing interests, experiences, education and lives of their own.

Eventually they become adults.

They can build careers, form relationships, move home and develop responsibilities beyond the family household.

Your family keeps changing as the years pass.

So do you.

STUDY, GROW AND CHANGE DIRECTIONEducation is part of everyday Life.

Choose what to study and balance it against work, money, relationships and everything else demanding your attention.

Manage study time, modules, assignments, deadlines and exams.

Qualifications can unlock opportunities much later.

Sometimes changing your future means sacrificing something in the present.

LIVE OUTSIDE WORKPlan mornings, afternoons, evenings and weekends.

Explore Life Places. Eat out. Exercise. Shop. Meet friends. Go on dates. Attend events. Pursue hobbies. Spend time with family or stay home.

Join Group Chats, receive invitations, organise plans and attend parties, weddings, gigs, festivals, dinners, sporting events, nights out and reunions.

Take holidays and short breaks, choosing where to go, how to travel, where to stay and what to do while you're there.

Some days are routine.

Others become memories your character carries for years.

LOOK AFTER YOURSELFHealth, energy, stress and mental load all affect what your character can realistically handle.

Push too hard and other areas of Life may begin to suffer.

Health concerns can lead to playable appointments, treatment decisions, follow-up care and choices involving time, money and wellbeing.

Looking after yourself is a decision.

Ignoring it is one too.

DEAL WITH THE SERIOUS PARTS OF LIFELife can become complicated.

Legal and civic matters can bring evidence, deadlines, costs, formal processes and consequences.

Housing disputes, relationship breakdown, financial problems and other situations can develop into something larger if they are not resolved.

Later Life brings new decisions around retirement, wills, beneficiaries, inheritance and your estate.

Eventually, every Life leaves something behind.

LIVE THROUGH THE YEARSLIVORA is designed around the long view.

Careers change.

Relationships evolve.

Children grow.

Parents age.

Money compounds.

Neighbourhoods change.

The economy moves through cycles.

Choices made years earlier can return in unexpected ways.

Eventually your character reaches the final chapters of their Life.

What remains is everything that came before: relationships, family, assets, memories, achievements, mistakes and consequences.

CONTINUE THE FAMILYA completed Life does not necessarily mean the end of the story.

If you leave behind an eligible adult child, you can continue the family through the next generation.

Begin a new playable Life connected to the one that came before it.

The world does not simply reset.

Family history remains.

Relationships are seen from a new perspective.

The child you once raised can become the person whose Life you now control.

And the family story can continue.

There is no perfect path through LIVORA.

No single definition of success.

Just thousands of decisions becoming one Life.

Build a life. Live with what follows.
description_short: Build a life that keeps moving around you. Create your character, work, study, manage money, find a home and form relationships as families grow, careers change, neighbourhoods evolve and thousands of choices shape what happens next.
